links.outcome: Antibiotic treatment of IPSO sepsis cases with versus without huddle intervention
links.effect: Antibiotic treatment was similar pre- and post-intervention without a huddle (9.3% vs 10.5%), but doubled with huddle intervention (22.7%).
links.quote: Treatment with antibiotics for IPSO sepsis cases was similar pre- and post-intervention without a huddle (9.3% vs 10.5%), though treatment doubled with huddle intervention (22.7%).
